name: logseq-selfhost-sync
description: Logseq Sync Server – self-hosted Logseq database synchronization service using the Node Adapter. Provides a private, self-hosted alternative to Logseq's official sync service for managing note synchronization across devices.

paths.name: Volume: Sync Data
paths.description: Logseq sync database and asset storage. Persists graph data and user information. Using an own share with Custom SMB-Shares Plugin (for specials Chars and Umlauts) on a trusted drive is recommended!

variables.name: --- Storage ---
variables.description: Data storage for synchronization database and assets.

variables.name: DB_SYNC_PORT
variables.description: Port the sync service listens on inside the container

variables.name: DB_SYNC_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public URL for sync service. Tailscale: http://ip:8787. Reverse proxy: use HTTPS. See Requires section.

variables.name: DB_SYNC_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Path to data directory inside container

variables.name: DB_SYNC_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error

variables.name: --- Cognito Authentication ---
variables.description: Logseq Cognito OAuth2 credentials for JWT validation. These are standard Logseq public values.

variables.name: COGNITO_ISSUER
variables.description: Cognito issuer URL for JWT validation

variables.name: COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Cognito client ID for JWT validation

variables.name: COGNITO_JWKS_URL
variables.description: Cognito JWKS URL for JWT key validation

variables.name: --- Advanced ---
variables.description: Advanced security and administration settings. Only modify if you know what you are doing.

variables.name: DB_SYNC_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional: Long random secret for hardening maintenance/admin endpoints. Leave empty to disable.
